# Synthetic statement fixtures

**Everything in this folder is invented test data.** The five `*_synthetic.xlsx` files and
the cp1251 CSV are generated by `make_fixtures.py` with openpyxl; they are scaffolds that
exercise different plausible column orders (title blocks, header on row 1 or row 4, debit
before credit and the reverse, one signed amount column, English headers, datetime cells vs
text dates, amounts as numbers vs `"1,000,000.00"` / `"750 000"` text). They are **not**
samples of any bank's real export and make no claim about real formats. Real exports, once
obtained, replace the seed placeholders in `nyabo_mn/nyabo/seed/bank_layouts.json` through
the learn-and-verify flow (ARCHITECTURE §5.4, DECISIONS CORE-08) — never by editing these.

| File | Bank label | Shape |
|---|---|---|
| `khan_synthetic.xlsx` | Khan Bank | title rows + account number, header on row 4, `Огноо / Гүйлгээний утга / Зарлага / Орлого / Үлдэгдэл / Лавлах`, opening and closing rows |
| `khan_synthetic_cp1251.csv` | Khan Bank | same lines as `;`-separated CSV in cp1251 (the code page has no Ү/Ө, so narratives use only encodable letters) |
| `tdb_synthetic.xlsx` | TDB | header on row 1, datetime cells, `Огноо / Лавлах дугаар / Дебит / Кредит / Валют / Гүйлгээний утга / Үлдэгдэл` |
| `golomt_synthetic.xlsx` | Golomt Bank | one signed `Дүн` column, day-first text dates |
| `transbank_synthetic.xlsx` | Trans Bank | credit before debit, narrative after the amounts, no balance, text amounts |
| `xacbank_synthetic.xlsx` | XacBank | English headers, `Withdrawal` before `Deposit`, timestamps as text |

`layouts.json` holds the matching **test** layouts (`verified: 1`, ids `test_*`); the flow
tests insert them as `Nyabo Bank Layout` rows. Regenerate with:

```bash
python tests/fixtures/statements/make_fixtures.py
```

The tests import the builders directly (`tests/fixtures/statements/make_fixtures.py`) so a
missing or stale file can never make a test pass or fail by accident.
